shape: nobody talks about a small, true feeling everyone has had

slides.text: nobody talks about the relief when a stranger hands you a tissue, then [[looks straight out the window]].

caption:
giving someone a napkin without asking what happened is the quietest kind of good.
a stranger who lets you hide in plain sight stays with you for years.
send this to the friend who always changes the subject when your voice starts to crack.

#kindnessmatters #kindnessquotes #randomactsofkindness
alt: A one-slide post about the quiet relief of a stranger offering a tissue and looking away to give you privacy, with a small green donkey looking relieved.
